scope.mode: Independent final PLAN-only closure audit after round-7 corrections and schema-3 regeneration.

scope.severity_rule: Critical/high only for a direct unmet requirement, contradiction, unsafe or undefined path, or material evidence overclaim. No implementation, full reachable-product model, fresh evidence retrieval, or semantic review was required.

contract_reproduction.basis: PLAN.md:3-4 and README.md status correctly state that this is a plan, not a working controller, and keep immutable re-fetch and human semantic review as future blocking gates.

Manifest IRB06/IRB09 and IX03/IX04 describe that path, but the closed rollback vocabulary at manifest line 660 omits REMEDIATION_WAIT, so the reducer's unknown-symbol rejection invalidates the path.

Manifest IR03/IR04/IR24 and the canary-generation invariant at lines 756-757, 779, and 849 require one active pair, terminal/quiescent/effect-and-rollback-settled/clean history before replacement, absent-or-same replay, and fencing of delayed historical receipts.

Manifest IR38 and IR56 separately bind direct E06 and reconstructed E17 success to the same decision, bounds, generation, and effect identity; lines 846 and 951 make them mutually exclusive and the only widening-success exits.

The IW/IP table covers E20/E21/E24/E25/E28/E29/E37/E39, but the same Effect machine permits non-cancellation terminal FAILED_FINAL exits E09/E10/E30/E31/E33/E35. No synchronized widening or promotion row consumes those terminal outcomes.

PLAN.md:238 and manifest line 936 require degradation to commit first and pause/stop exposure, while active exposure/progress states require HEALTHY. IH01 changes only HEALTHY to TELEMETRY_DEGRADED, creating a tuple that the same invariant says is unreachable.

Promotion exposed IW/IP counterparts start rollback in IP*X, but widening IW*X only says to begin required rollback without changing rollback_state or creating a saga. IR13A later requires a verified bound rollback. Manifest line 853 also says IR19/IR22 are the only synchronized rollout/rollback entry rows despite IP*X doing the same.

ICL01 accepts final C02 or C12 for success, but ICL02 accepts only C02 for failure. C12 remains a legal PENDING-to-CLEANED retention receipt and can be the last item for FAILED work, leaving no synchronized owner for the CLEANING-to-FAILED fold.

findings.title: REMEDIATION_WAIT is excluded from the reducer's closed rollback vocabulary
findings.requirement: PLAN.md:238-240 requires forbidden, stale, or exhausted rollback failure to enter REMEDIATION_WAIT/BLOCKED and remain nonterminal through real remediation and verification; manifest line 654 rejects unknown symbols and line 660 declares the closed rollback_state vocabulary.
evidence: Reducer priorities at lines 672 and 678, IRB06 at line 862, IRB09 at line 867, IX03 at line 904, and the exact witness at line 943 all use `REMEDIATION_WAIT`.
Round-7 resolution claims reducer symbol closure and successful rollback-remediation witnesses, which cannot both hold under the declared closed vocabulary and unknown-symbol rejection.
findings.impact: IRB06 cannot commit a valid ImprovementTupleV1. Final rollback failure and cancellation during that failure therefore have no defined legal reducer path.
findings.required_plan_correction: Add REMEDIATION_WAIT to the authoritative rollback_state vocabulary and regenerate the symbol-closure/reachability checks and schema-3 current-byte package.

findings.title: The HEALTHY invariant makes a degradation event during active exposure uncommittable
findings.requirement: PLAN.md:238 says control degradation commits a pause before more exposure receipts and active canary/widening/promotion progress requires HEALTHY. Manifest lines 663 and 936 reject impossible tuples and forbid active exposure states with degraded, paused, or failed control.
evidence: IH01 at manifest line 915 changes only control health from HEALTHY to TELEMETRY_DEGRADED; it does not synchronously pause or abort rollout.
Manifest line 936 includes CANARY_RUNNING, WIDENING_EFFECT, APPROVED, PROMOTING, PROMOTED, and OBSERVING in the HEALTHY-only set and also says the degradation event commits first.
Applying IH01 in any listed state creates the exact forbidden tuple, so invariant checking must reject the event; no synchronized IH01 plus rollout-pause/abort row exists.
findings.impact: Loss of continuity can be rejected instead of durably recorded and fenced at the moment exposure is active, which is an unsafe control path and contradicts the claimed R7-INT-005 repair.
findings.required_plan_correction: Define exhaustive synchronized degradation rows that atomically record degraded health and move each active rollout/exposure state to its safe paused/aborting state, then update witnesses.

findings.title: Widening and promotion omit legal direct terminal Effect failure exits
findings.requirement: PLAN.md:228 requires every nonterminal Effect state to have a total bounded disposition, and manifest lines 667 and 923 require every component event to have one exact legal product projection. The requested terminal-effect product audit must cover every declared terminal Effect exit, not only UNKNOWN-origin exits.
evidence: Effect rows E09, E10, E30, E31, E33, and E35 at manifest lines 543-544 and 564-569 legally reach FAILED_FINAL without passing through E20/E21/E24/E25/E28/E29/E37/E39.
The synchronized IW/IP rows at lines 813-846 enumerate only E20, E21, E24, E25, E28, E29, E37, and E39; IR43 and IR55 cover only E34.

With rollout WIDENING_EFFECT or PROMOTING, the omitted terminal Effect can settle while rollout remains unchanged. The reducer then exposes REVIEW or MERGE_QUEUED, but no rollout-coordinate recovery/failure edge exists.
findings.impact: A normal pre-send, send, or retry terminal failure can strand widening or promotion in an active rollout state or permit an unauthorized-looking canonical fallback without a legal rollout transition.
findings.required_plan_correction: Add mutually exclusive exposure/no-exposure synchronized product exits for every reachable terminal Effect edge in WIDENING_EFFECT and PROMOTING, or formally prove and guard those edges unreachable in each context.

findings.title: Exposed widening failure requires rollback but has no rollback-saga entry row
findings.requirement: PLAN.md:238 and manifest lines 846 and 952 require exposed widening failures to complete real rollback before cleanup, with exactly one later cleanup owner.
evidence: Each IW*X row at manifest lines 813-843 moves WIDENING_EFFECT to CANARY_ABORTING and says `begin abort/required rollback`, but none changes rollback_state IDLE->REQUESTED or creates the rollback saga.
IR13A at line 766 later requires the bound rollback to have reached verified/rolled-back, while IRB01 can start only from REQUESTED.
Manifest line 853 says IR19 and IR22 are the only synchronized rollout/rollback entry rows. This both leaves IW*X without an entry and contradicts IP*X rows, which explicitly perform IDLE->REQUESTED.
findings.impact: An exposure-classified widening failure reaches CANARY_ABORTING but cannot start the rollback whose verification is required for IR13A, so abort settlement and cleanup are unreachable.
findings.required_plan_correction: Give every IW*X row an atomic, uniquely owned rollback IDLE->REQUESTED saga creation, or add one exact subsequent entry row and correct the exclusivity statement and witnesses.

findings.title: Failure terminalization has no synchronized owner when the last CleanupItem closes through C12
findings.requirement: Manifest lines 926-934 require ICL01-ICL03 or IX04 to be the sole atomic owner of the last cleanup fold and terminal parent projection; generic C02/C09/C12 must not terminalize the improvement parent.
evidence: C12 at line 604 is a legal PENDING->CLEANED transition using a legal-hold/retention receipt, and PLAN.md:415 permits verified retention receipts for cleanup.
ICL01 at line 930 explicitly accepts final C02 or C12 for success, but ICL02 at line 931 accepts only C02 for failure.

For a failure tuple whose last required item legally takes C12, the cleanup fold becomes CLEANED and the reducer's exact failure conjunction changes canonical CLEANING->FAILED, yet neither ICL02 nor another synchronized row owns that event.
findings.impact: A valid retained cleanup item can leave FAILED work unable to terminalize or force generic C12 to violate the single-owner rule.
findings.required_plan_correction: Permit C12 in ICL02 with the exact failure guards, or explicitly forbid and justify C12 for every failure cleanup manifest.
